summary: Accurate weather forecast, radar maps, simple to use
description: An exceptionally easy-to-use app to stay informed of weather conditions in your area and around the world. See at a glance the next change in weather conditions - Weather forecast for the next 10 days - Hourly forecast - Fast, beautiful and simple to use - Detailed forecasts for rain, snow, wind and storms - Daily: dew, UV index, humidity and air pressure - Highest and lowest historical values - Satellite and weather radar map animations - Optimized for both phones and tablets - Great widgets for your home screen - Available on your favorite smartwatch. Full support for Wear OS - Severe Weather Alerts: receive useful information about severe weather warnings Consult the alerts issued by the official national weather service on upcoming extreme weather conditions, such as heavy rain with risk of flooding, severe thunderstorms, gale-force winds, fog, snow or extreme cold with blizzards, avalanches, heat waves and other important alerts. Alerts for extreme weather conditions come from each country's official national weather service. Find out more about the list of countries with alerts: https://exovoid.ch/alerts - Air Quality We display data measured by official stations, more info: https://exovoid.ch/aqi Generally the five key pollutants displayed are: • Ground-level ozone • Particle pollution including PM2.5 and PM10 • Carbon monoxide • Sulfur dioxide • Nitrogen dioxide - Pollen The concentration of different pollen are displayed. Pollen forecasts are available in these regions: https://exovoid.ch/aqi We continue to actively work to add new regions to provide information on air quality and pollen. Smartwatch App Feature List: • Included: "Tile" and "Complications" • Check the weather for your current location or any city in the world (requires main app to sync cities) • Hourly and daily weather forecasts • Info available hour by hour: Temperature, Probability of rain, Wind speed, Cloud cover, Humidity, Pressure, UV index • Touch the screen to view the information available hour by hour • Weather Alerts • Settings screen for customization Try it now ! -- Location data during the use of App Unlike many other apps on the market, we never send information like your location to a server, everything is processed on your device. We've designed our weather apps so that the user's precise location remains on the phone and is converted into the nearest weather station ID. What's more, weather requests linked to a station are not stored, so it's impossible to link a user to a weather request. This method ensures anonymity and security for the user. Our weather apps can be used without any form of localisation, you can manually set a location using the search screen. The app will display the forecast for this location each time you will open the app, without trying to localize you. We don't collect any personal information from our users. Privacy Policy & Terms of use: In order to use our apps, please accept our privacy policy and review conditions for third-parties such as advertising partners. https://www.exovoid.ch/privacy-policy
